issues.failure_explanation: In Step 2 of the proof of Lemma A.4 (labelled lemma: strengthened CS), the author estimates the sum over $z \in \widehat{\VV}_m$ of unsquared patch energy norms by $\enorm{\widehat{w}_k}$. Since this is an $\ell^1$-sum of local norms over $\#\widehat{\VV}_m \sim \widehat{h}_m^{-d}$ patches, for any fixed non-trivial $\widehat{w}_k \in \widehat{\XX}_k^1$ (e.g. with $k=0$), each local norm scales as $\widehat{h}_m^{d/2}$, causing $\sum_{z \in \widehat{\VV}_m} \enorm{\widehat{w}_k}_{\widehat{\omega}_m^n(z)}$ to scale as $\widehat{h}_m^{-d/2} \enorm{\widehat{w}_k}$, which diverges as $m \to \infty$. Thus, the unsquared sum cannot be bounded uniformly by $\enorm{\widehat{w}_k}$.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: In Step 1 of the proof of Lemma A.4, keep the local patch norm $\enorm{\widehat{v}_k}_{\omega_{\ell'}(z)}$ rather than bounding it by the global norm $\enorm{\widehat{v}_k}$. Then in Step 2, apply the discrete Cauchy-Schwarz inequality to the sum of products of local norms $\sum_z \enorm{\widehat{v}_k}_{\omega_{\ell'}(z)} \enorm{\PP_{\ell',z}^1 \widehat{w}_k} \leq (\sum_z \enorm{\widehat{v}_k}_{\omega_{\ell'}(z)}^2)^{1/2} (\sum_z \enorm{\PP_{\ell',z}^1 \widehat{w}_k}^2)^{1/2}$, which is bounded by $\lesssim \enorm{\widehat{v}_k} \enorm{\widehat{w}_k}$ by finite patch overlap.
issues.overall_effect: The proof of Lemma A.4 fails as written. Because Theorem 6.2 (theorem: AS operator) invokes Lemma A.4 in Step 3 of its upper bound proof, the upper bound of Theorem 6.2 and the condition number estimate in Corollary 6.3 (theorem: AS condition number bound) are left unproved until the step is repaired.
issues.title: Invalid unsquared patch norm sum in proof of strengthened Cauchy-Schwarz inequality
issues.why_classification: A standard, local repair using Cauchy-Schwarz on the sum of squares establishes the exact stated bound of Lemma A.4 without requiring any modifications to the statements, constants, or downstream theorems.
